File:/home/mark/PROJECT/JMAP/crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs:161
Issue: handle_chat_changes (line 66) was refactored to delegate to jmap_server::handlers::handle_changes. handle_chat_query_changes (line 161) was not similarly refactored and still contains ~70 lines of duplicated logic identical to the generic jmap_server::handlers::handle_query_changes. This inconsistency is confusing: a reader comparing chat_changes and chat_query_changes will expect both to either inline or delegate, not one of each.
Fix: Replace handle_chat_query_changes body with a call to jmap_server::handlers::handle_query_changes::<Chat, B>(backend, args).await, mirroring handle_chat_changes.
title: handle_chat_query_changes does not delegate to generic handler
